summary: This workflow filters records to a single program (Care Navigation) and then summarizes the result by summing savings and counting claims. It scores 1 out of 10, meaning it is a direct translation to SQL. Both tools used have simple, well-known SQL equivalents, so there are no design decisions or rework needed.

key_components.description: Data is passed through and filtered down to only records where program equals Care Navigation using the Filter [3].
The filtered data is grouped by program, summing savings and counting claim IDs using the Summarize [6].
The summarized results are passed on as output.
